title: Replica Skill for Claude Code (v2, real demos)

phrases.speak: What if Claude Code could rebuild an entire app?
phrases.show: What if Claude Code could rebuild an entire app?

phrases.speak: Same booking flow. Brand new app. Built by Claude Code.
phrases.show: Same booking flow. Brand new app. Built by Claude Code.

phrases.speak: It starts with Replica Skill. Eleven free Claude skills, MIT licensed, on GitHub.
phrases.show: It starts with Replica Skill. Eleven free Claude skills, MIT licensed, on GitHub.

phrases.speak: They research, design, build, test, and rebrand an app.
phrases.show: They research, design, build, test, and rebrand an app.

phrases.speak: Install it in two commands: add the marketplace, then install the plugin.
phrases.show: Install it in two commands: add the marketplace, then install the plugin.

phrases.speak: Step one, recon. Claude Code studies the app, and maps its screens, flows, and features.
phrases.show: Step one, recon. Claude Code studies the app, and maps its screens, flows, and features.

phrases.speak: Here, four screens, and a nineteen row feature matrix.
phrases.show: Here, four screens, and a nineteen row feature matrix.

phrases.speak: Step two, build. It writes a fresh app called SlotNest, with its own colors and its own words.
phrases.show: Step two, build. It writes a fresh app called SlotNest, with its own colors and its own words.

phrases.speak: Then the real test. We ran nine browser checks, and all nine passed.
phrases.show: Then the real test. We ran nine browser checks, and all nine passed.

phrases.speak: The parity check scores one hundred out of one hundred, and the brand sweep found nothing from the original.
phrases.show: The parity check scores one hundred out of one hundred, and the brand sweep found nothing from the original.

phrases.speak: It is not magic. Shared bookings still need a real server, and a perfect clone is never guaranteed.
phrases.show: It is not magic. Shared bookings still need a real server, and a perfect clone is never guaranteed.

phrases.speak: It can read customer reviews too, but it never invents one. Every quote needs a real link.
